  "w01": "Thomas stepped onto the slippery granite rocks just beneath the beacon, where the frothing tide receded into the grey Atlantic dawn. Among the tangled ribbons of kelp, a heavy green glass bottle caught the morning light. He knelt, thumbing the wax seal that had preserved the rolled parchment inside against salt and storms. Sliding the cork free with his pocketknife, he unfurled a brittle sheet covered in hurried, elegant copperplate script: 'If this reaches the cliffs of Cape Despair, tell Sarah the schooner never sank, and I am waiting where the map ends.' Thomas looked past the breaking waves toward the horizon, wondering how many decades the tide had guarded that solitary promise.",
  "w02": "凌晨四点的城市退去了白昼的喧嚣，笼罩在一层清冷的薄雾之中。高耸的楼宇静默伫立，零星的窗口还透着微弱的暖光，像是夜空遗落的星辰。街道空旷而寂静，偶有清扫落叶的沙沙声与远处的鸣笛遥相呼应，整座都市在深沉的呼吸中静候破晓的曙光。",
  "w03": "• Recursion is when a task solves a big puzzle by repeatedly solving smaller, identical versions of that same puzzle.\n• It always needs a simple stopping point, called a base case, so it knows when the work is completely finished.\n• Think of it like opening nested Russian dolls until you reach the tiniest solid doll inside, then closing them back up."
